a.lede: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.
a.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.

b.lede: The success of blockbuster hits like Project Hail Mary and Verity is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.
b.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
